answer.thought: The garden closes at nineteen-thirty, and the air has turned sharp with the coming night. I have walked nine kilometers and the body protests with a hunger that no amount of philosophical reflection can assuage. I must return to the bungalow to eat, or at least to find something to quiet the stomach before the dark sets in completely.
